title: An expanded chart with nothing to show reads "No data for selected date range"
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as {User-A} (for example Admin ShopView), whose role has the Reports permission, at location {Location-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST Empty 14 Oct A).
  • Your browser window is at least 1024 pixels wide at 100% zoom (a maximised laptop or desktop window).
  • {Location-A} is a location made for this test, with no invoices and no clocked time at all.
custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top bar.
  2. Click View details on Billing Efficiency and read the chart area.
  3. Click View details on Technician Efficiency and read the chart area.
  4. Click View details on Technician Utilization and read the chart area.
  5. Click View details on Revenue and read the chart area.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Steps 2 to 5: Each chart area reads "No data for selected date range", including the Revenue chart, because there are no sales at all.
  • Steps 2 to 5: None of them shows the dashed outline with the chart icon, and no error appears.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9581 (Story 9, Chart Behavior); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850, version 48 (14 Oct 2026, 17:09 UTC, Chris Ward), S9-R11 (added in version 45 on 14 Oct 2026 (15:06 UTC) by Chris Ward, from Chris Ward's answer 15 of 14 Oct 2026 to our question sheet; the spec's change log (version 46) lists it under 2026-10-14; reworded in version 48 on 14 Oct 2026, 17:09 UTC, from Chris Ward's answer 16 of 14 Oct 2026 to our question sheet, so a Revenue range with no sales at all also reads "No data for selected date range"); read 14 Oct 2026. Page change: https://shopview.atlassian.net/wiki/pages/diffpagesbyversion.action?pageId=788430850&selectedPageVersions=44&selectedPageVersions=45 and https://shopview.atlassian.net/wiki/pages/diffpagesbyversion.action?pageId=788430850&selectedPageVersions=47&selectedPageVersions=48. Source-verified 14 October 2026. Not yet checked against a build.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-R11: “An expanded chart with nothing to show for the selected range reads "No data for selected date range", the message these charts already use in production. The dashed empty-chart outline is only for the sparkline on a tile (S4-R12 to S4-R18). A chart has nothing to show when no point in the range has a value, or when every point is zero, the same test the tile uses (S4-R13). On Revenue that includes a range with no sales at all; a range with some sales still draws its $0.00 days as real points (S4-R11a).”
